title: Late Application Charges on Courtesy Rider Permit Fees and Fee-Waiver Corrections (Student Transportation Services)
content:
The fee-waiver adjustment of a Student Transportation Services courtesy rider permit fee never reaches a late application charge. The application charge the permit fee carries is taken out of the fee before the waiver share is applied, and depends on the day the assignment's application was received:

| Day the assignment's application was received | Application charge the permit fee carries |
|---|---|
| after the permit period's first school day (August 12, 2026 for a school-year or fall semester fee; January 6, 2027 for a spring semester fee) | 25.00 USD |
| for a school-year or fall semester fee: after July 15, 2026, and on or before August 12, 2026 | 15.00 USD |
| any other day, or the assignment has no application date | none |

## Both sides of each date (hypothetical school-year applications)

| Application received | Charge |
|---|---|
| July 15, 2026 | none |
| July 16, 2026 | 15.00 |
| August 12, 2026 | 15.00 |
| August 13, 2026 | 25.00 |

For a spring semester fee only the first school day matters: an application received on or before January 6, 2027 carries none, and one received on January 7, 2027 or later carries 25.00.

## Example (hypothetical)

A fee of 205.00 USD on an application received on August 20, 2026 carries a 25.00 charge, so the fee-waiver adjustment acts on 180.00.
